title: AIR CONDITIONING-FRAME & GASKET
summary: Air-conditioned cars (C60): a slotted frame and matching gasket that mount over a row of rectangular openings on a body panel (two side-by-side frame/gasket sets shown). The gasket goes between panel and frame, and the frame is held with production screws into J-nuts clipped on the panel edge (production nuts at the other holes).

fastening.to: body panel with the rectangular openings
fastening.note: Frame [3] with gasket [2] behind it sits over the openings; production screws [B] go through the frame and gasket holes into J-nut [1] clipped on the panel edge and into the production nuts [A] (4 [A] callouts shown along the panel). One [B] screw drawn; holes are at each end and between the slots.
Gasket [2] seals between frame [3] and the panel.

notes_internal: Location on the car not labeled; the panel with slots appears to be the cowl/plenum area but this is not stated.
Exact count of screws and nuts not given; drawing shows 1 J-nut [1], 5 nut positions tagged [A] (two leaders from one callout), 1 screw [B].
